lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102110112 · After Working Holiday Group Chat chat 3. I used to dream about summer vacation.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Anis

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: I don't know if you realize this,

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: but your texts have been coming through this entire time.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: You really do enjoy talking to yourself...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I did no such thing!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 03:01 Anis: I used to dream about summer vacation.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 03:01 Anis: The sky would be clear blue.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 03:01 Anis: The sea was emerald green.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 03:02 Anis: Instead, I'm lumped together with Sugar, going full castaway.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wait

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why are those still there?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I thought I recalled all those!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: I dunno.
Maybe you only deleted them on your end?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What's the difference?

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: I think I see what's going on here.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: If you recall the text, the record itself is fully erased,

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: whereas deleting it merely takes it off your phone, not everyone else's.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oooh, I gotcha.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Hehe

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Hehe

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hey! Have all of you been synchronized? Stop laughing at me!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 10:55 Anis: None of my messages are getting through.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 10:55 Anis: It's starting to feel like I'm talking to myself.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Haha.
We were getting all of your messages, every last one.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: You have no idea how bad I felt for you, Anis.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: And the Commander was replying to every text as well.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: He was?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I honestly thought none of them were going through...

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Okay, then.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Care to elaborate on this little exchange?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 10:57 Anis: I can see it now.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 10:57 Anis: The Commander is on the beach, surrounded by girls in swimsuits.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 10:57 Anis: Each of them with different intentions...

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: 10:57 Anis: Argh!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: What exactly did you mean by 'different intentions'?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Different what?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Are you saying there may be other spies in our midst besides me?
True. It would stand to reason that Neon wouldn't be the only spy in a team this large.
I'm not sure myself.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Uh-oh,

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: so I'm not alone!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Can the other spy, please raise your hand?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Actually...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't really know.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: What? But you were the one who said it in the first place.
No one replies.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Anyone?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Why'd everyone go quiet all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Usually, the culprit is the one who gets tight-lipped.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Wait, are you saying everyone here is...?!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Unless...

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Everyone who's innocent, type out a '1'.
